remediation-policy.reuseSelectsAnEligibl: Reuse selects an eligible linked session first. Archived or explicitly paused sessions cannot be resumed automatically. A new session requires the Agent Worker and Runner Device selected below.
remediation-policy.rebaseRequiresForceWi: Rebase requires force-with-lease against the expected remote head. A changed head requires reconciliation.
remediation-policy.anyOneSelectorMayMatc: Any one selector may match. Identities and required current permissions must be verified before execution. Names and bot suffixes do not identify an account or App.
remediation-policy.noReviewerSelectorsPu: No reviewer selectors: published feedback cannot trigger automatic handling. It remains available for manual action.
remediation-policy.useTheExactIdsFromVer: Use the exact IDs from verified feedback author or App details. User, bot and App identities are separate.
remediation-policy.enabledPoliciesRunBou: Enabled policies run bounded fixes for linked pull requests when the Agent, Runner Device, and current evidence are eligible.
remediation-policy.sessionStrategyExecut: Session strategy, execution targets, conflicts, attempt limit, and reviewers.
